captions.detailed: A professional-scale speedlight camera flash consisting of a tall matte black body housing, an exposed U-shaped neck cradle, and a rectangular flash head with a white translucent lens. The neck assembly is mounted on a swivel base above the body, and the upper flash head is suspended between the arms of the cradle. A rectangular battery door panel is visible on one side of the lower body.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a professional speedlight camera flash. The design must feature a rectangular matte black battery housing with a distinct side door panel, a rotating neck cradle assembly on a vertical swivel, and a rectangular flash head with a translucent white lens that tilts horizontally between the cradle arms.
captions.factory: The speedlight is constructed using three main parts: a base body, a neck/cradle assembly, and a flash head. The base body is created by unioning a main box with a stepped neck connector, and subtracting a side-cut box to define the battery door panel. The neck assembly is built with a central vertical pivot cylinder, a horizontal crossbar, and two vertical side brackets. The flash head is created from a rounded-edge box, with a rectangular front pocket subtracted to fit a white translucent lens plate. Continuous and revolute joints are defined to allow the neck to swivel on the body, the head to tilt on the neck, and the battery door to rotate.
